description: TypeScript route handlers running in-process on the swerver (Zig) engine via an FFI park/resume bridge: a matched request is handed from the reactor to a Bun handler and its response taken back, with no socket hop. The engine installs as a platform prebuilt (no build step) and fans out one worker per core over SO_REUSEPORT. HTTP/1.1 only for now; the prebuilt is built without the native-only TLS/HTTP2/HTTP3 flags.
